_doc: Marquee spec: the places that must be unforgettable in every province. Source of truth for docs/MARQUEE.md (render with node tools/marquee/render_md.js) and for the batches of docs/MARQUEE-PLAN.md. Names and positions only; no game text. Fields: tier S/A/B (build order), effort S/M/L (S = data/kit only, M = new plan + small kit/builder, L = new landmark builders or new structure code), sil = layout silhouette tag (unique across settlements), lm = signature landmark, pal = palette, bld = 3 named buildings, npc = 3 [name, hook], q = signature quest chain (t title, s stages, u what makes it unlike the others), need = what code/blocks it needs. place_* fields are filled from places/*.json (exists=false means the id must be added).
legal: Facts (names, layout, positions) only; all text original.

provinces.pitch: The heart of the Empire: the Rumare as a silver spine, the Nibenay's ayleid ruins and vineyards, snow on the Jerall rim. Nine cities that must each read differently from far away.

settlements.pal: white marble, gold trim, green lawn
settlements.brief: Concentric rings of districts on a lake island, one bridge, the Tower punching 210 blocks above everything. Each district gets its own street-width, roof colour and trees; the Market, Arena and Temple districts are separate walled wards you pass through, not one blended grid.
bld: Temple of the One (white nave, gold ribs)
npc: Ayleid glyph copyist who needs a bodyguard into old ruins
runs the Elven Gardens night watch, owes a smuggler a favour
Arkay priest in the Temple who hears confessions that matter

s: Find the sealed sewer grate under the Waterfront District
Map three Ayleid cisterns that predate the city
Retrieve the Alessian seal from a flooded vault
Choose: return it to the Palace or the Arboretum librarian
q.u: the only Cyrodiil chain that is a multi-district urban delve with a real choice

settlements.need: Existing bespoke layout; add district colour/roof variance per ring (kit overrides per street rank), 6 named wards as sign-bearing plazas. Needs a district-tint option in the plan format.

settlements.pal: whitewash, spruce beams, slate, snow caps
settlements.brief: A mountain town climbing a switchback valley under the Jerall ridge: terraces stacked above a fast stream, chimney smoke everywhere, a tall Talos chapel spire as the crown. The Cyrodiil town that feels half-Nord, with steep steps and snow-load roofs.
bld: Great Chapel of Talos (tallest spire in Cyrodiil)
The Jerall View Inn on the switchback
npc: Legion captain watching the pass, wants a courier she can trust
candles sold with a rumour of what lies behind the Cloud Ruler
chapel keeper, copies fragments of the Dragon-Blood prayers

s: Win a stair-race up the town terraces
Escort a sledge of relics through a blizzard pass
Defend the chapel bell tower from raiders
Ring the old bell: wakes something under the ridge
q.u: a winter-weather endurance chain with the town's verticality as the course

settlements.need: New cityplan: valley-terraces form (zoning HILLTOP with a stream axis), nordStyle-like kit variant 'imperial_alpine' (spruce beams, snow-slate roofs). Landmark: chapel spire (reuse TALOS builder scaled up).

settlements.pal: weathered grey-green plank, reed thatch, rope lantern
settlements.brief: A drowned-looking city piled up a steep river-bay hill: stairs and rope bridges between leaning plank houses, laundry lines, a statue of the Lucky Old Lady at the top. Grimy, vertical, smoke and mist; the reference city that looks poor, not pretty.
bld: The Lonely Suitor Lodge (leaning, ten storeys of balconies)
npc: fishwife and information broker, trades secrets for eels
one honest guard, stonewalled by the Count's clerk

s: Learn the local legend of the statue from three tellers
Follow a skooma barge up the river at night
Catch the Count's clerk at the counting-house
Decide whether the statue's secret stays secret
q.u: a slum-detective chain, vertical stealth through rope bridges; none of the other cities are poor

settlements.need: New plan: SLOPE form with stacked plank houses, many rope BRIDGE spans, stairs (needs STAIRS street archetype or use terraces); kit 'imperial_slum' (plank/reed/spruce). Statue landmark new.

settlements.lm: Castle Skingrad on its rock crown
settlements.pal: warm limestone, terracotta tile, grapevine green
settlements.brief: A hill town ringed by terraced vineyards and cypress lines, a walled castle on the rock crown, and a long viaduct road. Colours are ochre and green, not grey: the Cyrodiil of wine, mild weather and old family feuds.
bld: Colovian vintner's press-house with open cask yard
The Two Sisters Lodge (arbour courtyard inn)
npc: vintner with forty-year-old casks and a Merovane problem
rival vintner, offers a poisoned-bottle commission
keeps the Count's ledger and a missing page

s: Trace a spoiled shipment back to a cooper
Catch the saboteur during the harvest festival
Judge the feud: seal one cellar or merge them
q.u: the only light, comic/social chain; a harvest-festival set piece

settlements.need: Kit 'imperial_warm' (limestone/terracotta); a VINEYARD yard-prop set (rows, press, casks) in zoning outskirts; hill plan with castle crown (reuse CASTLE landmark scaled).

settlements.pal: white plaster, blue glazed tile, sea-rope
settlements.brief: A crescent harbour: a white mole curling out to a tall lighthouse, fish-market quays, blue-roofed houses on two terraces, and a castle block at the seaward point. The sea-facing, bright and breezy contrast to inland Cyrodiil, with boats you can actually board.
bld: Lighthouse keeper's tower with beacon stair
npc: keeps the manifests, hides a name
knows which ships don't come back
retired smuggler, will sell you a map

s: Climb the lighthouse: the lamp was dimmed on purpose
Tail the night ferry to a sea cave
Sink or capture a wrecker's skiff
Relight the beacon with a ceremony the town hasn't seen
q.u: a coastal wreck-and-smuggle chain, built around a ship you can ride

settlements.need: Harbour form in zoning with mole and lighthouse landmark (reuse lighthouse blueprint); kit 'imperial_coast' (white/blue). Boats from the sailing module.

settlements.pal: scorched basalt, new pale timber scaffolds, ash
settlements.brief: A slope city half-ruined by an Oblivion Crisis: rebuilt wards in pale new timber against black scorched stone, a hole-in-the-ground where the Gate opened, and a castle with one wall still down. A city mid-recovery, readable at a glance.
bld: Chapel of Arkay as a field hospital
Temporary stone-and-canvas market under the arena stands
npc: captain of the Guard, hates ceremonies, loves the Count
tends the refugees, keeps a roll of the lost
rebuilder who found something in the rubble

s: Help rebuild a ward by hauling stone
Find the list of the lost in the chapel crypt
Follow a survivor's trail into the crater-edge ruins
Seal a minor Gate remnant before the wall is rebuilt
q.u: a recovery/rebuilding chain, where progress physically changes the town

settlements.need: Plan with 'damaged' flag: partial-ruin shells + scaffold props (Props); add REBUILD variant state (data: per-stage building list swapped on quest stage - needs a world-state hook). Gate crater landmark exists (kvatch_gate).

settlements.pal: oak timber, green slate, honey stone
settlements.brief: A town gathered round an ancient oak so large that its canopy roofs the central green, houses of honey stone and timber under it, a timber-gate wall and a tiled-roof guildhall. The only Cyrodiil town with a living centre rather than a tower.
bld: The Oak Hall (guild hall built into the root buttresses)
The Hungry Heron Inn under the canopy
npc: steward trying not to be her grandfather
maintains the Oak, knows it is sick
priory scribe with a letter that should not exist

s: Examine the Oak and take bark samples
Brew a cure from three roadside herbs
Hold the Oak against beetle swarms for a night
Choose: preserve the Oak or fell it to save the town's wells
q.u: nature-health chain for a single living landmark

settlements.need: Reuse GIANT_TREE builder at 'great_oak' scale 30; plan with green and radial lanes. Kit 'imperial_oak'. Low risk.

settlements.lm: Great Chapel and the stone bridge
settlements.pal: white stucco, blue tile, ash-grey Dunmer quarter
settlements.brief: A canal-split town: the river Corbolo bisects it, with two bridges and a mixed quarter where Dunmer refugees built flat-roofed ash-grey houses beside Nibenese blue tile. Identity is the visible cultural seam down the middle.
bld: Great Chapel with Dunmer shrine annex
npc: hall warden, keeps the roll of arrivals
old Cheydinhal merchant, unwilling to share the market
guard captain who plays both sides fair

q.t: The Empty House by the Wall
s: Hear both sides of the market quarrel
Search the empty house the refugees refuse to enter
Find the Ordinator hiding in the cellar
Broker the peace or expose the landlord
q.u: a two-communities mystery chain; only quest with a culture split in one town

settlements.need: Zoning CANAL form with cultural kit split by street side (needs per-side style: plan 'quarter_style' field). Dunmer kit already exists.

dungeons.brief: A buried Ayleid city-vault of lit welkynd stone: tiered cisterns, bridges over drowned galleries, glowing crystal-lamp halls and a cold vault of sealed names. Vertical, blue-white, no torches.
dungeons.boss: The Last Warden of Miscarcand (an unlit Ayleid lich)
npc: scholar, will pay for glyph rubbings
shade who speaks Ayleid, wants his name restored

s: Open three lamp-gates by solving a light puzzle
Choose to free or bind the shade
q.u: light-and-water puzzle dungeon using lit lamps as the door mechanic

dungeons.need: Data-driven marquee plan: ayleid theme rooms (cistern, lamp-gate, nave); needs welkynd-lamp block (lit/unlit states) and a water-level room variant. Existing Theme RUIN + CultureRooms.

dungeons.brief: A mountain-top Akaviri fortress with a barrow of dragon-hunters beneath: pagoda-curved halls above, long tomb galleries below. A climb up exposed ramparts, then a descent.
npc: old Blade, hints at what is below

s: Open the barrow with the three Dragonguard sigils
Carry the oath to a Blades keeper
q.u: only Akaviri-themed mountain climb; surface-to-underground double structure

dungeons.need: Special entry 'sancre_tor' (data plan): FORT exterior + BARROW interior stitched; curved-roof Akaviri kit already in Cultures.

dungeons.brief: A single obsidian spire on a rock in a cold sea, no stairs: levitation or boat to the door, inside a spiral of study floors, a storm-room at the top and a flooded basement.

s: Cross the water to the spire
Find the lever-less floors by magic
Descend into the basement and free the apprentice
q.u: vertical tower quest that is mostly about movement spells, not combat

dungeons.need: Use SurfaceBuilder mage tower; add a 'no ground entrance' flag, ferry NPC; levitation puzzle uses magic module.

dungeons.brief: A coastal cave with a drowned lower level, a moon-lit sink-hole and a bone-white hall of the Hollow Court. Lower tides expose different rooms.
dungeons.boss: Countess Vaelia, the Hollow Court's Matron

q.u: time-of-day/tide-gated dungeon

dungeons.need: Cave theme with tide state (world time check on a 'tide gate' block); new vampire court room set.

dungeons.brief: A hidden cellar-sanctuary under a nondescript house: a small dark crypt-warren, a shrine to the Night Mother, a communal hall and a locked inner coffin-room.
dungeons.boss: The Listener's Shadow (no boss: a choice)
npc: old assassin, keeps the Black Door

s: Resolve by killing, sparing or defecting
q.u: moral-choice chain; no boss fight required

dungeons.need: Existing 'dark_brotherhood' faction hooks; data plan for a small socials-dungeon (no enemies unless provoked).

landmarks.brief: The burning crater edge where the Gate first opened: ash plume, wrecked siege-tower, a ring of lava-glass.
landmarks.moment: A timed Oblivion Gate assault: three waves and a closing ritual; the plume visible 300 blocks away.
landmarks.need: Reuse oblivion_gate structure; add crater/ash scatter and plume particle emitter.

landmarks.brief: The Blades' keep on a cliff over cloud: banners, wind, a rope bridge, a view of the whole Jerall range.
landmarks.moment: Climb to the Blades' roof at dawn; the whole province is visible in one panoramic sweep.
landmarks.need: Fort kit with cliff mount; use the existing FORT structure with a viewing balcony.

landmarks.brief: A lone statue guardian on a ridge, hand raised, facing the Valus road.
landmarks.moment: Standing at the statue's feet marks the Cyrodiil/Morrowind border; the sky changes tone.
landmarks.need: Existing monument variant; add a larger statue builder variant.

landmarks.brief: One of the six great Alessian gate-ruins with its scroll-temple annex, worn.
landmarks.moment: Visiting all six unlocks a pilgrim's cache.
landmarks.need: Existing monument + altar; a visit counter in discovery data.

minors.brief: A cloister of grey stone with a bell and an orchard.
minors.hook: A cloister of grey stone whose scribe, Brother Hesk, has lost a letter that should not exist.

minors.brief: An inn half on the bridge, half on the bank; lanterns on the span.
minors.hook: An inn half on the bridge; a card-sharp there loses on purpose to hide something.

minors.brief: Rickety lake docks lit by moonlamp.
minors.hook: Rickety lake docks lit by moon-lamps; the dock ledger hints at a werewolf among the crew.

minors.brief: A half-dug Ayleid cut-away with scaffolds.
minors.hook: A half-dug Ayleid cut-away; scholars have been vanishing at the dig face.

minors.brief: A hidden waterfall pool that mirrors the sky.
minors.hook: A hidden waterfall pool that mirrors the sky; the hermit sells directions to it.

minors.brief: A single-family cellar estate with a stone press.
minors.hook: A cellar estate whose latest vintage has poisoned a guest; the owner blames a rival.

provinces.pitch: Ash, mushrooms, ziggurats and volcano glow. Four Great House kits and a Tribunal temple exist, but every Dunmer town currently picks one at random. Each major place needs a unique skyline: Vivec's cantons, Ald'ruhn's crab shell, Sadrith Mora's spore towers, Necrom's tomb city.

settlements.pal: dark basalt ashlar, saffron gold, bronze lantern
settlements.brief: Six pyramidal cantons standing in water, joined by long arched bridges, with the Palace as a stepped ziggurat at the centre. Each canton is a different job (Foreign Quarter, Arena, Hlaalu, Redoran, two temples), and the great ring of water must read as one city from the shore.
bld: Arena Canton fighting pit with hanging banners
Foreign Quarter Plaza (tented bazaar over the water)
Temple of the Tribunal canton chapel (stepped, lamp-lit)
npc: Temple warden of the Hlaalu canton, secrets and stairs
maintains the water-gates, knows what's beneath
pilgrim guide who sells the wrong ending

s: Locate the flooded canton foundations by boat
Seal a leak that is also a theft
Face the Warden's choice: hide the leak or call the Temple
q.u: the only chain that uses boat travel between districts as the central mechanic

settlements.need: Existing bespoke layout; give each canton a distinct style/roof via per-canton kit overrides, named canton signs, and add the Palace stepped-tier landmark upgrade. Water-level bridge arches exist.

settlements.lm: Almalexia's temple dome and Royal Palace
settlements.pal: white marble, gold, deep blue glass
settlements.brief: A walled white-and-gold citadel: a huge domed Temple, a palace behind a great plaza, and the Great Bazaar as an enclosed arcade street. Beneath the city, 'Old Mournhold' is its ruined twin: the same plan, dark, sunken, and hostile.
npc: temple politics, wants a quiet inquiry
bazaar guildmaster, smuggling in plain sight

s: Take a bazaar contract that hides a map
Find an entrance to Old Mournhold
Cross the twin-plaza ruin to the vault
q.u: the only chain with a mirrored 'twin city' underworld

settlements.need: Existing bespoke; add the Bazaar arcade archetype (long covered street spec) and a mirrored undercity dungeon plan (old_mournhold) using the same Cities.mournhold coordinates.

settlements.pal: clay-yellow plaster, dark-oak balconies, saltrice sack colour
settlements.brief: A river town on both banks of the Odai: low, spreading Hlaalu houses on terraces, a high stone bridge between, a giant silt strider docked at the south side. Warm yellow clay and orange tile, not black basalt: the commercial city.
bld: Guild row on the bridge (Mages, Fighters, Thieves fronts)
Hlaalu Council Manor with stepped terrace garden
Silt-strider port tower and caravan yard
npc: merchant prince, wants a rival's ledger

s: Fence a ledger for Dron on the south bank
Steal the second from the Council Manor
Lure the third into a river bridge ambush
Choose: sell all three to the Temple or burn them
q.u: a mercantile heist chain across two banks and a bridge, the only heist with a bridge fight

settlements.need: Zoning RIVERSIDE plan with a bridge spine and silt-strider dock landmark (SiltStriderEntity exists); Hlaalu kit exists, add warmer palette entries.

settlements.lm: Skar: a gigantic upturned emperor-crab shell
settlements.pal: bone-white chitin, brown lacquer, red banners
settlements.brief: A fortress-town built inside and along a monstrous crab shell: the Skar, ribs forming gate arches and long halls, houses clustered along the ridge, Redoran banners on every post. A silhouette you can't mistake: one long curved hump on the horizon.
bld: Skar Hall (the great shell chamber, Redoran council)
Redoran Guild-Hall barracks with chitin ribs
The Rat-Walk Inn on the shell's outer ridge
npc: knows mine tunnels beneath the town

s: Witness a Redoran duel at the shell's gate
Track the poisoner into the egg-mine tunnels
Present proof to the Council and accept a duel
q.u: honour-duel chain; the climax is a formal duel in front of a council, not a dungeon boss

settlements.need: New landmark: SHELL (ribbed curved hull from Canvas curves) + cityplan with the shell as the spine; Redoran kit exists. Needs a chitin-block palette; use bone_block/ivory + dark_oak.

settlements.lm: The Wizards' Tower and the Telvanni Council spire
settlements.pal: violet cap, teal glow, bone-white stem, glowshroom lanterns
settlements.brief: A cluster of giant fungal towers rising from an ash-flat on a lagoon: each noble's tower a different cap colour and height, with narrow rope footbridges and glowing spore-lamps at night. No streets, only stems.
bld: Council Spire (tallest cap, open meeting terrace)
Rope-bridge tavern (a cap-hall hung between two stems)
npc: levitating Telvanni, bored, offers a petty bet
tends the glowing gardens, afraid of a new strain
wants to leave her master's tower

s: Accept Gaenor's wager: an item stolen from another tower
Cross four rope bridges and one levitation gap
Choose to return it or bring it to the other Magister
q.u: a tower-to-tower infiltration with magic gimmicks; Telvanni humour

settlements.need: Telvanni kit exists (mushroom towers). New plan: TOWER_CLUSTER with rope bridges, per-tower cap colours (wool/terracotta glazed), glow at night via sea-lanterns. Landmark MUSHROOM_SPIRE builder.

settlements.lm: The great tomb temple of Necrom
settlements.pal: pale ashlar, bone-white, deep green moss, purple banners
settlements.brief: A city of the dead and the living: ancestral tomb-houses in terraced rows climbing a hillside, with a central temple, processional avenues lined by lanterns, and a harbour. Narrow, quiet, solemn: a procession is the street plan.
npc: a widow who lets no outlanders enter
gravedigger unwilling to dig one grave

s: Learn whose grave Aldrin will not dig
Track the heir to a farm
Retrieve a family relic from a sealed tomb
Perform the burial or let the line lapse
q.u: a family-ghost mystery with a funerary ritual finale

settlements.need: New plan: TERRACED rows with a processional avenue; velothi kit exists; MAUSOLEUM archetype (HALL_OF_DEAD variant) in numbers.

settlements.lm: The Underworks canton in a cliff cavern
settlements.pal: basalt black, red lava glow, rust-orange
settlements.brief: A town cut into a sea cliff with a lava-lit grotto at its heart: the Temple canton reached by long cut stairs, houses balanced on ledges above a glowing channel, ash spray from the surf. Red light and black stone from far off.
bld: Underworks Canton (grotto temple with lava channels)

s: Descend the lift to the Underworks
Lure a magma elemental into a quenching pool
Seal the vent: costing you something
q.u: environmental-hazard chain: lava and heat as the puzzle

settlements.need: New plan: CLIFF form (like Markarth's CLIFF landmark) with a lava-channel yard feature (lava blocks with obsidian edging, safe). Redoran kit exists.

settlements.pal: imperial white stone, red banners, dark Dunmer canton quarter
settlements.brief: A bastion fortress and harbour town: a star-shaped castle on a river island, a long bridge to a grid of Imperial streets, a Dunmer quarter jammed outside the wall. The rigid Imperial plan against organic Dunmer clutter.

s: Learn who is selling gate keys
Confront Corvus or disarm the plot
q.u: political/intrigue chain between two communities at the gate

settlements.need: Zoning GRID + a 'star bastion' wall spec (wallRing with corner bastions); Dunmer quarter via mixed-style option (shared with cheydinhal).

dungeons.brief: A blasted ash-fortress at the foot of the Red Mountain: broken keeps half-buried in drifts, cracked red-lit halls and a collapsed amphitheatre; ash storm in the courtyard. Ruin, not tomb: wind and glass.

s: Choose: burn the throne or preserve it
q.u: weather-driven dungeon: ash storms damage and hide enemies, braziers pace the fight

dungeons.need: Data plan: ruin + ash weather volume; needs ashfall particle and visibility fog in this structure box (visual module hook).

dungeons.brief: A huge ancient Velothi shrine fortress with a sunken lower temple of a long-silent god: dusky green stone, great doors, cold wind. A sacred place, not an enemy den; halls designed for pilgrims.

s: Pass three trials of the ancient path
Bear a prayer to each of three shrines
Choose: take the relic or leave it sealed
q.u: a sacred pilgrimage dungeon, mostly traps and rituals

dungeons.need: Data plan with long processional hall rooms; needs a 'pilgrim trial' room kind (trap + prayer lectern).

dungeons.brief: A Dwemer city-hall of cranking bronze: giant gear-halls, steam vents, a centrifuge chamber at the core and a high catwalk looking over a fabrication floor. Strong vertical and mechanical.

q.u: engine-puzzle chain; each solved room visibly changes the level

dungeons.need: Existing DwemerRooms; add gear-bank puzzle room (redstone-free: lever sequences, existing Puzzles).

dungeons.brief: A conveyor-and-forge hall: long assembly lines of half-built animunculi and a forge-pit finale; foundry glow, hammer sounds.

s: Defend the forge from rogue constructs
Rebuild it or break the line
q.u: build-a-companion chain; uses existing animunculi_forge blueprint

dungeons.need: Use animunculi_forge blueprint at scale; data plan chain.

dungeons.brief: The sunken twin of Mournhold: the same plazas lying one level down, lightless, with collapsed arcades and a flooded bazaar. You pass under streets whose upper siblings you walked.
npc: a ghost keeping a single light

s: Follow the lamps along the old arcade
Choose to douse the last lamp or relight the city
q.u: a mirror-city dungeon; the geometry matches the surface city

dungeons.need: Reuse Cities.mournhold coordinates in an underground plan; needs a 'mirror plan' option that offsets the city plan 20 blocks down.

dungeons.brief: A corrupted ashland sanctum of blighted stone, red crystal growths and corprus-ridden chambers; a descent through ash-choked halls to a pulsing chamber.

q.u: blight-themed with disease mechanic; rooms contaminate

dungeons.need: Existing 'sixth_house_base' variant; add blight status effect rooms (disease module).

landmarks.brief: A bruised volcano whose ash plume shades the sky, with a glowing crown and a ring of broken wall.
landmarks.moment: The Ghostfence line glows red as you cross; the distance fog turns ember-orange.
landmarks.need: Terrain exists; add the ashen cloud layer + glow wall at the Ghostfence.

landmarks.brief: A long wall of shimmering ghost-light, broken at gate-posts, enclosing the mountain.
landmarks.moment: Walking through a gate-post gives a brief ward-shimmer shader; guards at each.
landmarks.need: New wall-line landmark and gate post set.

landmarks.brief: Two giant antlered peaks over the coast, one broken, with a pilgrims' ladder.
landmarks.moment: A shrine at the top has a view of cantons; one-way glide drop.

landmarks.brief: A green flat of old standing shrines in ash grass.
landmarks.moment: A ceremonial circle where the sky is oddly clear.

landmarks.brief: A tall brass-pipe tower on a rock island whose top vents steam.
landmarks.moment: At dawn the spire sings; use as a navigation beacon.

minors.brief: A tiny customs-house port at a lagoon edge with a silt-strider stop and a pier.
minors.hook: The customs-house ledger does not add up, and the clerk has gone to bed ill.

minors.brief: A fortified hill village with a half-built fort and a granary.
minors.hook: A hired guard who vanished from a half-built fort with his wages.

minors.brief: A harbour village of one temple and many boat-houses.
minors.hook: A boatman sells ash-glass cheap and insists it is not from the temple.

minors.brief: A single street on a cliff with a long wooden stair to the water.
minors.hook: Seal-hunters bring up a catch that glows, and will not eat it.

minors.brief: A muddy-swamp town raised on stilts with a mangrove market.
minors.hook: A mudcrab smuggler who pays in pearls and will not say where from.

minors.brief: An Ashlander camp of yurts under hide, a wise woman's fire in the centre.
minors.hook: A young Ashlander must complete a coming-of-age trial and needs a witness.

minors.brief: A single huge mushroom tower on a lagoon, a master and his servants.
minors.hook: A servant who wants to flee the tower has hidden a forbidden book in her bedding.

minors.brief: A tidal fishing village of smoke-racks.
minors.hook: A net-boat has gone missing and the whole village has stopped talking about it.

provinces.pitch: A half-Nord, half-Dunmer island: ash-fall in the south, blizzards in the north, Skaal and Raven Rock between. Already has 40 lore places and 22 quests; what it lacks is settlements that look different from each other and a few unforgettable set pieces.

settlements.lm: The Bulwark wall and the ebony shaft head
settlements.pal: ebony grey, Redoran green, ash-streaked timber
settlements.brief: A mining colony inside a hastily-built stone bulwark: grey ebony-spoil heaps, a headframe over the shaft, Redoran long-houses and a ring of crude gate towers. Ash drifts on the windward side; a harbour wharf of rough planks below.
bld: Ebony mine headframe and ore-sorting shed
Temple of the Tribunal chapel, shrunk to a single hall
npc: ebony miner, hides a fatality count

s: Count the missing miners with the foreman
Decide: seal the shaft or break the mine's curse
q.u: a mine-collapse horror chain; uses the shaft head as the town's centre

settlements.need: Existing wall ring; add ebony spoil heap props and a headframe landmark (MINE archetype has one). Kit Redoran.

settlements.lm: The All-Maker stone circle and bonfire
settlements.pal: whale-bone white, pelt brown, snow, blue ice
settlements.brief: A ring of low hide-and-bone houses around a central stone circle and fire: no streets, only a trodden snow circle, drying racks, hanging totems. Not a Nord village: smaller, more communal, with a sacred hearth at the exact centre.

s: Find the missing verse in a distant cave
Choose: sing it as written or as it happened
q.u: an oral-history chain that ends in a ritual, not a fight

settlements.need: New cityplan RING_SACRED form (like zoning RING) with a central stone circle yard; Skaal culture kit (bone/hide/pelt blocks).

settlements.lm: The great hall with rib arches
settlements.pal: spruce beam, bone ribs, rune-carved stone
settlements.brief: One immense hall: a walled compound around a single enormous mead-hall with whale-rib arches, a trophy yard and a fenced boar run. The only Skyrim-region location where the whole 'town' is a single building.
npc: chief who wants one more kill

s: Track the great beast across the snow
Bring it back alive or dead
Decide the hall's rule for the next season
q.u: a trophy-hunt chain, a boss hunt on open ground

settlements.need: Existing mead_hall variant; add rib-arch (WHALE_RIB landmark) over the hall door, trophy yard props.
